entities.name: Nachman Aronszajn

entities.summary: Nachman Aronszajn was a Polish American mathematician. Aronszajn's main field of study was mathematical analysis, where he systematically developed the concept of reproducing kernel Hilbert space. He also contributed to mathematical logic.
